title: R(k,S) as a Regime Response Surface in Energy-Flow Cosmology
abstract: Introduces a state-dependent gravitational response surface R(k,S) that extends EFC phenomenology from time/redshift dependence to dependence on a structural maturity variable S. The paper unifies prior µ(a) and µ(k,z) approaches, defines S operationally from the nonlinear-to-linear variance ratio, and formulates a falsifiable framework where a single global surface must describe all late-universe probes. It specifies DES Y6-oriented falsification criteria and posits that the L1→L2 transition explains the S8 tension.
